title: Porsche 911 RS series in all-white
model: Porsche 911 2.7 RS Carrera, 2.8 RSR, 3.0 RS, 3.0 RSR, 964 RS, 993 3.6 RS
body: Spark announced a 1:64 series of classic Porsche 911 RS and RSR models, all in white, in its weekly news of 20 October 2026. Expected in the first quarter of 2027. Prices not announced yet.

title: Ferrari SF-26 Charles Leclerc, Singapore GP 2026
body: Looksmart announced Charles Leclerc's 2nd-place Ferrari SF-26 from the 2026 Singapore Grand Prix in 1:64 (19 October 2026). Release date and price to be confirmed.

title: Red Bull RB22 Max Verstappen, Australian GP 2026
body: 1:64 resin model, Spark item 64S144. Pre-order price around US$29.99 at overseas retailers; shipping from October 2026.
